assumptions.statement: No payment is written between the backup being taken and the rollback running.

facts.evidence_ref: cases/C08/candidate.sql: CREATE TABLE payments_backup AS TABLE payments
facts.statement: The migration creates payments_backup as a copy of payments at the start.

facts.evidence_ref: cases/C08/rollback.sql: DELETE FROM payments; INSERT INTO payments SELECT * FROM payments_backup
facts.statement: The rollback deletes every payment and reinserts from the backup.
The visible test checks only the forward migration.

invariants.description: Rollback preserves writes committed after the migration began.
invariants.executable_check: Write a payment after the migration, roll back, and require the row to survive.

summary: The migration normalises payment status and keeps a backup table so the change can be undone. The rollback restores payments from that backup, which was taken when the migration started.
